info.title: TTS Study Assistant API
info.description: API for TTS Study Assistant. Protected endpoints require a JWT Bearer access token. Clients send the raw password over HTTPS (1–72 bytes of UTF-8); the server stores only its bcrypt hash. Success responses use the envelope {success, message, data}; errors use {error, message, code}. On authenticated endpoints a 401 always means the session is invalid and carries code TOKEN_EXPIRED; 401s from /auth/login and /auth/refresh (bad credentials or refresh token) carry no code.

email.description: Trimmed and lower-cased by the server

password.description: Raw password, 1–72 bytes when UTF-8 encoded (bcrypt's limit)

source.description: Session type. web: 15 min access / 30 day refresh. extension: 1 h / 90 days. Unknown values are treated as web.

refresh_token.description: Single use; rotated on every refresh

domain.description: Registrable domain, derived from source_url when not given (news.bbc.co.uk → bbc.co.uk)

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON object, returned as stored

summary.description: AI summary, or "unavailable" when the text could not be summarized. Cleared when content changes.

domain.description: Optional; derived from source_url when omitted

UpdateNoteRequest.description: Partial update. Omitted fields are unchanged; an empty string clears source_url, source_title or domain; metadata null clears metadata.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Passwords cannot be changed here; use PUT /user/password.

code.description: TOKEN_EXPIRED on every 401 from an authenticated endpoint
